{{AnimeLocationInfobox |name=Red Rock Isle |characters=赤岩島 |japanese=Sekigan Isle |image=Red Rock Isle.png |imagesize=250px |caption=Red Rock Isle |region=Johto |epicode=EP214 |episode=Mantine Overboard! }} '''Red Rock Isle''' (Japanese: '''赤岩島''' ''{{tt|Sekigan|Red Rock}} Isle'') is an {{pkmn|animated series}}-exclusive location in [[Johto]], and one of many small islands in the [[Whirl Islands]] archipelago. The [[Whirl Cup]] is held here, in [[Scarlet City]]. ==In animation== [[File:Red Rock Isle map.png|thumb|200px|left|Map of Red Rock Isle]] {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} arrived on Red Rock Isle at the end of ''[[EP214|Mantine Overboard!]]'', when they were taken there by {{jo|Luka}}. It was the setting for the episodes from ''[[EP215|Octillery The Outcast]]'' to ''[[EP218|Plant It Now... Diglett Later]]''. The events of ''[[EP215|Octillery The Outcast]]'', ''[[EP216|Dueling Heroes]]'', and ''[[EP217|The Perfect Match!]]'' follow the annual Whirl Cup competition. In, ''[[EP218|Plant It Now... Diglett Later]]'' Ash and his friends visited [[Diglett Village]]. During the episode, they tried to protect the older residents of the town from a group of thieves who are attempting to steal the town's {{p|Diglett}} upon which the local economy is based, only to find out the thieves were the children of the older residents and were trying to help their parents. {{left clear}} ===Locations=== ====Cities and towns==== * [[Scarlet City]] * [[Diglett Village]] * [[Transit Town]] ===Gallery=== {| class="roundy" style="margin:auto; text-align:center; background: #{{ruby color}}; border: 3px solid #{{ruby color dark}}" |- style="background:#{{ruby color light}}" ! style="{{roundytl|5px}}" | {{color2|000|Scarlet City}} ! {{color2|000|Diglett Village}} ! style="{{roundytr|5px}}" | {{color2|000|Transit Town}} |- style="background:#fff" | [[File:Scarlet City.png|x150px]] | [[File:Diglett Village.png|x150px]] | [[File:Transit Town.png|x150px]] |} ==In other languages== {{langtable|color={{ruby color light}}|bordercolor={{ruby color dark}} |zh_yue=赤岩島 |zh_cmn=赤岩島 ''Chìyán Dǎo '' |de=Red Rock Insel |es=Isla Roca Roja |ca_vc=Illa Roca Roja |fr=Île de la Pierre Rouge |it=Isola Roccia Rossa |pl=Wyspa Czerwonego Kamienia{{tt|*|EP223}}
